attribution: Government of Quebec: RQA, Quebec Building Reference and SDA, CC BY 4.0; OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0
processing: Full merged world tiles; matched OSM buildings removed at >=35% overlap of smaller footprint; equal normalized address numbers removed within 20 m. Unmatched world features retained. Sparse missing tiles use the original world archive.
limitations: Source dates and positional quality vary. Not a survey or a guarantee of exhaustive real-world coverage. Antoine-Labelle only; not all Quebec MRCs.
